newsitem.title: USA: Conrail sees Norfolk offer having no impact.
newsitem.headline: Conrail sees Norfolk offer having no impact.

text.p: Conrail Inc and CSX Corp on Monday said Norfolk Southern Corp's latest effort to thwart their proposed merger would not affect the planned transaction.

"Today's announcement by Norfolk Southern changes nothing. The fact is the CSX-Conrail merger is the only transaction where Conrail shareholders can receive value for 100 percent of their shares," the railroads said in a joint statement.
Earlier, Norfolk Southern said it would seek to buy a stake in Conrail if Conrail shareholders defeat a provision viewed as critical to the planned union.
